title: Unmarked black helicopters arrive at Ellsworth
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: it over the next few weeks suddenly we had an influx of black shoy helicopters completely unmarked

plain: In the 1960s at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a crowd of black helicopters with no markings at all is said to have arrived over a few weeks. Michels relays this in an episode with Robert Hastings, a researcher of UFOs at nuclear bases, quoting a witness he does not name: "suddenly we had an influx of black... helicopters completely unmarked." The story suggests some secret unit moved in on the base after something unexplained happened there.
